title: 2.4.33 Challenges — Optional Stretch
sourceRef: designed — stretch bundle for §2.4 Loop Control and Nested Loops

steps.title: Hollow square
steps.instructions: Print a 6x6 hollow square using nested loops: a "#" on the border rows and border columns, and a space everywhere else inside.

steps.title: Sum every third number
steps.instructions: Loop through the integers 1 to 50. Using continue, skip every number that is NOT a multiple of 3. Add up the ones you keep and log the total.

steps.title: Multiplication table, skip multiples of 5
steps.instructions: Print a multiplication table for 1 to 12 using a nested loop, one row per outer number. Use continue to skip printing any row whose outer number is a multiple of 5.
